texts: A person stands, then lowers into a deep yoga squat with palms together at the chest, holds the squat, then stands back up.
A person stands, then lowers into Warrior II yoga pose with feet wide apart, front knee bent, arms stretched out to the sides, holds the pose calmly, then returns to standing.
A person stands, then bends forward and places both hands and feet on the floor, lifting the hips high into a Downward Dog yoga pose, holds it, then comes back to standing.
A person stands, then kneels down, then stretches the arms forward on the floor with hips high over the knees and the chest lowered into Puppy pose, holds it, then returns to standing.
A person stands, then sits down on the floor, rolls onto their back, and grabs both feet with knees bent toward the armpits in Happy Baby yoga pose, holds it, then rolls up and stands.
A person stands, then shifts weight onto one leg, places the other foot on the inner thigh, and raises both palms together overhead in Tree yoga pose, holds balance, then returns to standing.
A person stands, then kneels down, sits back on the heels and folds forward with arms stretched out in front and forehead on the floor in Child's pose, holds it, then returns to standing.
